statusDetail: The bare URL redirected this audit environment to an Akamai-blocked /uk locale. The same hostname’s reachable /us locale was audited across four representative templates; the locale substitution is disclosed in paths.

paths.description: LG USA homepage: global navigation, promotional hero, product discovery, personalization/tracking, and global quality signals. Selected because the requested bare URL’s /uk redirect was edge-blocked; this reachable locale represents the same hostname.
TV category/listing template: filtering, product discovery, carousel/navigation, and mobile controls.
OLED TV product-detail template: product identity, pricing, availability state, media gallery, and primary purchase action.
Support task hub: troubleshooting and repair journeys, search/input semantics, and responsive layout.

findings.guidanceId: dark-mode
findings.summary: The site does not adapt its chrome or surfaces to the user’s dark color preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot remains a light cream interface, and the computed `color-scheme` is `normal` under `prefers-color-scheme: dark`.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare `color-scheme` and provide dark-aware surface, text, border, and browser UI colors.

findings.guidanceId: accessibility
findings.summary: Motion continues when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe reported four running animations with durations of 600ms, 1400ms, 1400ms, and 6000ms while the media query matched reduce.
findings.suggestedFix: Use `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` to stop autoplay and replace nonessential motion with immediate state changes.

findings.guidanceId: accessibility
findings.summary: Some text and controls do not meet contrast requirements.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility reported `color-contrast` failure on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise foreground/background contrast and verify all interactive states against WCAG contrast thresholds.

findings.guidanceId: light-dismiss-a-dialog
findings.summary: Persistent sales-assistant and feedback overlays obscure product and navigation content.
findings.evidence: All mobile screenshots show a fixed Feedback tab plus a “Shop with an expert” bubble and avatar covering page content; the home mobile capture also shows several stacked sticky bars.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay nonessential prompts, avoid stacking promotional chrome, and keep content unobscured; offer a clear light-dismiss action.

findings.guidanceId: responsive layout adapt viewport mobile
findings.summary: The support template overflows horizontally at 360px.
findings.evidence: The support layout measured `scrollWidth: 367` against `clientWidth: 360`, a 7px horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Find the overflowing fixed-width or offset element and constrain it with intrinsic sizing and `max-inline-size: 100%`.

findings.guidanceId: improve core web vitals LCP INP CLS
findings.summary: The homepage is extremely slow under lab conditions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 12.8s, TBT 3,910ms, Speed Index 35.8s, and performance score 0.29; the independent trace measured LCP 19.61s and 729ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Set performance budgets, prioritize the LCP asset, and remove or defer work from the critical rendering path.

findings.guidanceId: prevent layout shift reserve space CLS aspect-ratio
findings.summary: Product content shifts materially during load.
findings.evidence: The product mobile layout recorded CLS 0.1266; image inspection found all 100 sampled homepage images lacked explicit width and height attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve media and dynamic UI space with intrinsic dimensions or `aspect-ratio`, and stabilize late banners/widgets.

findings.guidanceId: break-up-long-tasks
findings.summary: Heavy JavaScript blocks the main thread.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 40.1s main-thread work and 27.2s JavaScript execution; the trace found ten long tasks, the longest 480.7ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary script, split long tasks, and schedule noncritical work after interaction or idle.

findings.guidanceId: optimize-script-priority
findings.summary: The page ships an excessive request and byte payload.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 624 requests and 9.92MB transferred, including 181 scripts totaling 5.21MB and 540 third-party requests totaling 8.42MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce tags and variants, lazy-load noncritical integrations, improve caching, and preload only critical resources.

findings.guidanceId: accessible name label role form field aria
findings.summary: Interactive controls lack accessible names and labels.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed link-name and ARIA containment audits; probes found 15 unnamed buttons on category/support, 12 on product, and multiple unlabeled inputs.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a programmatic name, associate labels with fields, and repair invalid ARIA ownership.

findings.guidanceId: heading structure landmarks focus order keyboard
findings.summary: Page structure is incomplete for assistive technology.
findings.evidence: Category, product, and support probes found no `<main>` landmark; Lighthouse failed list structure, aria-hidden-focus, and accessibility-tree audits.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a single main landmark, correct list/ARIA structure, and ensure hidden regions cannot receive focus.

findings.guidanceId: target size zoom reflow captions viewport user scalable
findings.summary: Zoom and touch-target support are insufficient.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the meta-viewport zoom audit and target-size audit; the category probe found 47 of 154 visible targets below 24px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user zoom and enlarge or space controls to meet accessible target-size guidance.

findings.guidanceId: avoid console errors uncaught exceptions
findings.summary: The homepage logs browser errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported the `errors-in-console` audit as failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve uncaught/network console errors and add production monitoring that prevents regressions.

findings.guidanceId: baseline deprecated api bfcache source maps inspector issues paste prevention geolocation notification on load
findings.summary: The page uses deprecated APIs, triggers permission at startup, and cannot restore from bfcache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two deprecation warnings, geolocation-on-start, inspector issues, and two bfcache failure reasons.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated APIs, request location only after an explicit user action, and fix bfcache blockers.

findings.guidanceId: crawlable links viewport meta robots descriptive link text
findings.summary: Crawler/mobile signals have avoidable defects despite strong server-rendered coverage.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured 91% raw-HTML coverage, but Lighthouse found invalid robots.txt, a restrictive viewport, and 57 non-descriptive links.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix robots syntax, allow zoom, and replace repeated generic link labels with destination-specific text.

findings.guidanceId: https csp secure cookies content security policy
findings.summary: Transport defenses and cookie attributes are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers lacked HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy; the CSP only defines `frame-ancestors`. Cookie audit found 57 of 58 cookies without Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Add complete security headers and mark every HTTPS cookie Secure with intentional SameSite and HttpOnly attributes.

findings.guidanceId: data minimisation third party privacy analytics
findings.summary: The default third-party tracking footprint is exceptionally large.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture saw 110 third-party origins and 23 known tracker endpoints; HAR attributed 540 requests and 8.42MB to third parties.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit vendor necessity, gate nonessential tags on consent, consolidate analytics, and minimize retention and identifiers.

findings.guidanceId: autocomplete autofill address payment sign-in input assistance
findings.summary: Search and support inputs lack consistent labels and autocomplete semantics.
findings.evidence: Page probes found multiple text inputs with no associated label, no accessible name, and empty autocomplete values; support explicitly uses `autocomplete="off"`.
findings.suggestedFix: Add persistent labels, appropriate input types, names, and autocomplete tokens; do not disable autofill without a security reason.

findings.guidanceId: third-party scripts fonts video autoplay media budget cache resource efficiency
findings.summary: Third-party code and media exceed a reasonable page budget.
findings.evidence: The homepage transferred 9.92MB; 8.42MB and 540 requests were third-party, including 5.21MB of script and 3.57MB of images.
findings.suggestedFix: Set byte/request budgets, remove low-value vendors, and load chat, experimentation, and advertising only on demand.

findings.guidanceId: optimized images appropriate resolution page weight budget
findings.summary: Image markup misses basic responsive and stability optimizations.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 100/100 images without width/height, 30 without srcset, five oversized, and six without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions, responsive `srcset`/`sizes`, right-size transformations, and meaningful or empty alt text.
